title: THE STAKE
adds_note: THE LADDER (ladder) is substrate-variation plus the catalog it reaches through. it needs the draw and the measure already wired, and nothing else in the rail.
objective: seat THE LADDER between the head and the tail - reach up-tier - spend real budget

beats.title: the rim rod
lines: the core answered for free. it always will - that is the hearth.
further out, a rod sits behind a real rate limit. reaching it costs.
one unit of real budget, metered live. it can genuinely starve.
seat THE LADDER between THE DRAW and THE MEASURE. reach up. see what a stake costs.

beats.title: the reach - nothing hidden
beats.code:
POST /game/ignite
{ "spec": [ "tap", "ladder", "scorer" ],   # THE DRAW -> THE LADDER -> THE MEASURE
  "task": "t-01" }
     -> { "ok": true, "run_id": "..." }

GET /game/run?id=<run_id>
     -> links: tap -> ladder -> scorer
        ladder.receipt.rods   verdict.pass   cost_u
beats.note: THE DRAW alone stays on the free hearth. seat THE LADDER between the head and the tail and the draw reaches UP a tier to a paid rod - cost 1u, real budget, read live. one law comes free with the reach: if that rod is walled by a real rate limit, THE LADDER falls back to the hearth and the fire still closes. a survived fall is not a failure - it is RESTORABLE COHERENCE. seat the three parts, then fire.

beats.title: the reach
beats.label: dock the rim [F] - seat THE DRAW, THE LADDER, THE MEASURE - fire [Space]
beats.note: paid rod. this proof spends real budget - unless the wall sends it home to the hearth.
beats.earned: the ladder seated. the reach went up.
beats.reseat: unscored draw. seat THE MEASURE at the tail, then fire again.
beats.halted: a rod refused. re-seat the head and the tail, fire again.

beats.title: the receipt
beats.pass: run {run_id} - {total_ms}ms - cost {cost_u}. THE LADDER seated and the reach closed. a number is real budget spent; FREE means the wall sent it home and the ladder still closed. the receipt is real either way.
beats.fail: no ladder in the trace. a bare draw stays on the free hearth - seat THE LADDER between the head and the tail, fire again.

rewards.log: the stake - the reach lands, the meter reads
reveal: you seated THE LADDER and reached past the hearth.
cost {cost_u} - read live from the meter, not a guess.
a hairline grey notch is milled into the hull. reach earned, one ring inward. the light stays the mind's.
rewards.tag: honesty - cost {cost_u}, real budget or a survived fall. grey notch, no amber title - a stake is a reach, not a proven doctrine.
